description: Config file standardizer cases from the configuration-file specification (Silent Failure Cases, Duplication Handling, profile prefix rules, sso-session and services sections, case-insensitive keys), transcribed from the specification text and the configuration-file cases as ported in aws-sdk-java-v2 ProfileFileTest.

tests.name: Duplicate profiles in the same file merge properties.

input.configFile:
[profile foo]
name = value
[profile foo]
name2 = value2

tests.name: Duplicate properties in a profile use the last one defined.
Duplicate properties in duplicate profiles use the last one defined.

input.configFile:
[profile foo]
name = value
[profile foo]
name = value2

tests.name: Property keys are case-insensitive and stored lower-case.
Property keys differing only in case are duplicates.

input.configFile:
[default]
region = us-east-1
Region = us-east-2
REGION = us-west-2

tests.name: Property keys differing only in case are duplicates across duplicate profiles.
Sub-property keys are stored lower-case.
Default profile with profile prefix overrides default profile without prefix when profile prefix is first.
Default profile with profile prefix overrides default profile without prefix when profile prefix is last.
Default profiles with mixed prefixes in the config file ignore the one without prefix when merging.

input.configFile:
[profile default]
name = value
[default]
name2 = value2
[profile default]
name3 = value3

tests.name: Specification duplicate profiles example 2.

input.configFile:
[default]
aws_access_key_id = ACCESS_KEY_0
aws_secret_access_key = SECRET_KEY_0
region = us-west-1

[profile default]
aws_access_key_id = ACCESS_KEY_1

[profile default]
aws_secret_access_key = SECRET_KEY_1

[default]
region = us-west-1

tests.name: Profile prefix wins over a bare name in the config file.
Default profile in the credentials file is used.
Invalid profile names are ignored.
Invalid property names are ignored.
All valid profile name characters are supported.
All valid property name characters are supported.
Profiles duplicated in multiple files are merged.
Duplicate properties between files use the credentials property.
Case-differing properties between files use the credentials property.
Specification duplicate profiles in different files example 1.

input.configFile:
[default]
aws_access_key_id = ACCESS_KEY_0
aws_secret_access_key = SECRET_KEY_0
region = us-west-1

[profile default]
aws_access_key_id = ACCESS_KEY_1
region = us-east-1

tests.name: Config profiles without prefix are ignored.
Credentials profiles with prefix are ignored.
Config profile prefix without a name is ignored.
SSO session sections are parsed separately from profiles.

input.configFile:
[profile foo]
sso_session = dev
[sso-session dev]
sso_region = us-east-1
sso_start_url = https://example.awsapps.com/start

tests.name: SSO session sections accept extra whitespace and comments.
SSO session sections in the credentials file are ignored.

input.credentialsFile:
[test]
region = us-west-1
credential_source = Environment
sso_session = session
role_arn = some_Arn
[sso-session session]
sso_region = us-west-1
start_url = someUrl

tests.name: SSO session sections with invalid names are ignored.

input.configFile:
[profile section]
sso_session = sso invalid
[sso-session sso invalid]
start_url = url
[sso-session validSso]
start_url = Valid-url

tests.name: SSO session sections without a name are ignored.
SSO session sections duplicated in a file are merged favoring the later definition.

input.configFile:
[sso-session dev]
sso_region = us-east-1
sso_start_url = https://one
[sso-session dev]
sso_start_url = https://two

tests.name: SSO session sections do not need to be adjacent to profiles.

input.configFile:
[profile profile1]
sso_session = sso-token1
[profile profile2]
region  = us-west-2
[default]
default_property = property1
[sso-session sso-token1]
start_url = startUrl1
[profile profile3]
region = us-east-1

tests.name: Services sections hold per-service sub-properties.

input.configFile:
[profile foo]
services = my-services
[services my-services]
s3 =
 endpoint_url = https://localhost:1234
dynamodb =
 endpoint_url = https://localhost:5678

tests.name: Services sections accept extra whitespace and comments.

input.configFile:
[ 	 services 	 my-services-config 	 ] 	# Comment
s3 =
 endpoint_url = https://localhost

tests.name: Services sections without a name are ignored.

input.configFile:
[services]
s3 =
 endpoint_url = https://localhost
[services ]
s3 =
 endpoint_url = https://localhost

tests.name: Services sections in the credentials file are ignored.
